World side panel options

The column beside the map in World, in the app and on the online galaxy page. Mockups only: buttons don't do anything.

Today

Nine floating boxes in the app; the online card repeats Home and its level.

A · One sheet, folding sections

One panel. A fixed header with who you are, level and three numbers; each section folds to one line with a summary.

B · One panel, three tabs

Home / Build / Explore / Log in the app, Galaxy / Moments / Orders online. The panel is only as tall as the open tab. Direction is a compass, not a dropdown.

C · Icon rail, one card at a time

A strip of icons on the right opens one card beside it; your level moves to a small box top left. Build has a planet picker: Home and every colony (Ember and Tide are example colonies). Picking one flies the map there, and it follows the Home / colony buttons bottom left.
